branches.label: Bank offices (FDIC Summary of Deposits)
branches.period: as of June 30, 2024 (2024 Summary of Deposits survey)
branches.definition: Number of insured-bank office records (main office plus branches) reported in the FDIC Summary of Deposits for Citibank, N.A. (FDIC cert 7213), Citigroup's only FDIC-insured bank charter, aggregated by branch state (STALPBR) by the FDIC BankFind API ('count').

deposits.label: Deposits held in offices in the state (FDIC Summary of Deposits)
deposits.period: as of June 30, 2024 (2024 Summary of Deposits survey)
deposits.definition: Sum of branch-office deposits (DEPSUMBR, reported in $ thousands, converted to millions) for Citibank, N.A. (FDIC cert 7213), Citigroup's only FDIC-insured bank charter by branch state, as aggregated by the FDIC BankFind API ('sum_DEPSUMBR'). Deposits are assigned to the office where the bank books them, so main-office and booking-center states can be inflated relative to where depositors live.

notes: State rows are the FDIC Summary of Deposits, June 30, 2024 survey, for Citibank, N.A. (cert 7213), aggregated server-side by the FDIC BankFind API by branch state. Citibank has SOD offices in 12 states plus DC. FDIC totals for the query: 657 offices and $743,363,000 thousand. Deposits follow booking office: South Dakota (main office, Sioux Falls) shows 2 offices with $463.9 billion, and Texas 2 offices with $30.8 billion, which reflect where deposits are booked, not where depositors are. Delaware shows 1 office with $0 deposits. Puerto Rico (2 offices) is in the FDIC response but is not a state; omitted. Regions: the 10-K human capital table splits ~229,000 employees into North America 86k and International 143k (Mexico in International; by business and region, not physical residence); the 10-K gives no country breakdown and no list of the region's countries. 10-K Item 2 Properties reads 'Not Applicable', so the only site is the headquarters from the cover page. Citi's per-country websites were not used (no consistent dated set).
